nom: ANUA PDRN Caffeine Rejuvenating Eye Cream

segments.dry: Dry-skinned reviewers report mixed results: one describes worsened dryness, burning and irritation, while another says the applicator felt cooling and moisturizing on first use before later causing redness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say the cream caused no irritation even where other retinol eye products had, but one reports waking with itchy, red under-eyes and warns sensitive-eyed users to be careful.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 50s reports the cream helped with under-eye bags used as needed before events.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report reduced appearance of fine lines, crepiness or smoother texture with continued use; a few see no change in fine lines even after two to four months of twice-daily use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as hydrating or moisturizing under the eyes; one finds it not moisturizing enough and needs to reapply within hours, and one reports increased dryness and darker-looking skin.
concerns.redness: Several sensitive-skin users report no redness or irritation, but multiple others describe new redness, itchiness or a burning sensation after use, with one explicitly warning people with sensitive eyes.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports a burning sensation and irritation that made her skin look darker and more irritated overall.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report brighter or lighter dark circles and reduced discoloration under the eyes, sometimes within one to two weeks; a couple see no change in dark circles after extended use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the formula as non-greasy and quickly absorbing, with no reports of oiliness or breakouts.

extraits.texte: I have noticed the skin around my eyes looking really dry after using this product. The skin has not turned brighter, in fact, it looks darker and irritated from the eye cream. Theres a burning sensation when i put it on now. Not sure if its because of how dry my skin is. Makeup doesnt look good. It makes the dryness more obvious.

Every other aspect of this product is great. I love the applicator, it feels very luxe and cooling, and my dry eyes loved this upon first application. However, every time I've used this, I've woken up with an itchy red undereye area. Anyone who has sensitive eyes, be careful.

UGH i love anua so i was soooo excited to try this product. I've been using it for a month now, and the only difference I see after use is redness. It doesn't help with puffiness at all :/ in fact, i feel like my eyes have been even more puffy recently in the mornings and I'm just now realizing it may be the cream. Only giving it two stars bc of applicator and packaging

extraits.titre: Cooling and non-irritating for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: Loving this product right now! It goes on smoothly and blends flawlessly into my skin. It doesn't merely sit on the surface but truly absorbs well. The applicator tip feels cool and soothing on what can only be described as "tired mom eyes" in the mornings. There is zero odor to the product and I have not had any irritation to my skin and I have VERY sensitive skin especially on my face. It doesn't magically erase my eye bags but it sure feels wonderful!

I have been using this eye cream for about 5 months now and I am very satisfied on the results. I have very sensitive skin and I have used other retinol products around my eyes and had a very bad reaction to it but not this one. I put it on over my face moisturizer and under my concealer and no it does no smudge my make up. It has brighten and it has reduced the creases around my eyes.

I deal with dark circles and dull skin under my eyes so I thought I would give this cream a shot since I trust the Anua brand.A tiny dot is all I need and it absorbs well without any greasy residue or heavy scents. I have sensitive skin and this doesn?셳 irritate it at all!It seems to moisturize and brighten under my eyes well and even though it is a tiny tube, since a little bit is all you need, I see this lasting me a long time.So far, I am pleased with the results and plan to actually purchase another when I run out!
On my daughter's wedding day, my niece applied some eye cream and it helped with the bags under my eyes. Since then I have been using cream as needed. Mainly for meetings or going out.
